verdict: Leads stopped this week — spend gaps caused it, fix is in motion.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 77 leads at $8.60 per lead, but that number masks a sharp drop in the final week: zero leads came in across six straight days (Sep 11–16), tied directly to days when ad spend went to zero. Even on days when spending resumed, delivery did not recover immediately, which tells us the campaigns need time to restabilize after the gaps. Ad spend is being monitored daily to prevent any further zero-spend days, and the campaigns are being actively reviewed to restore delivery. You should expect leads to begin recovering in the coming days as delivery normalizes.
